title: Our driver was wonderful....
text: Our driver was wonderful.   He suggested taking the gondola up the mountain.  I'm so glad he did.  The views were amazing.
author: Roger_S

title: Extraordinary experience!
text: Extraordinary experience. Our guide was wonderful and coordinated the trip for us based on our schedule. Xavier was a wonderful travel partner and made sure that we had the most wonderful experience not only during the tour but during our stay and provided us with recommendations!  I highly recommend and you will NOT be disappointed!!!
author: georgiasM9097OX

title: Private Montserrat tour
text: Fabulous driver, lovely vehicle, amazing destination. Highly recommend this as a very comfortable way to see Montserrat
author: Mandy_S

title: A fantastic day with a private tour to Montserrat
text: A fabulous day with a wonderful guide who could not have been more helpful or knowledgeable. A very comfortable vehicle & very relaxed.
author: mandysK7599IO

title: Amazing customer service!
text: Xavier was amazing! Corresponding with him to organize our day trip from our hotel to Montserrat was a breeze - he was communicate, thoughtful and everything was planned to the last detail - he also suggested a super cool private tour guide for us, gave us some excellent restaurant recs and we used him again to our transfer back to the airport. Thank you!
author: misssocial_nyc81
